 IT Traineeship - 9 November 2026 
 Amsterdam, Remote 
 Your mission 
 Looking to start your IT career in the Netherlands as a refugee? The Motopp IT Traineeship offers a 6-month program with training and mentorship, preparing you for full-time roles at top companies like PwC, Rabobank, Alliander, Achmea and many others. 
 Start your IT-career with Motopp 
 Over the course of 27 weeks, you will prepare, together with eleven other trainees, for a career in the Dutch IT sector. How? Through a combination of technical IT skills training, insights into Dutch work culture, and workshops to develop essential soft skills. You will learn software development, gain an understanding of how the workplace operates in the Netherlands, and participate in sessions on topics such as presenting, assertiveness, and teamwork. The traineeship is fulltime and conducted in English. 
After completing the training, we will start mediation towards a paid job at one of our partner companies across the country. If we find a match, for the next 18 months we will continue to support you with personal coaching sessions, evaluations, and additional workshops. 
 Step-by-Step Program 
 - IT Bootcamp (14 weeks): Trainees develop technical skills and explore their ideal IT role. Topics covered are: Project Management, Requirements Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Back-end Development (Python, FastAPI), Testing, Cloud Computing, Software Testing, Information Security, Data analysis. - Internal Internship (13 weeks): Apply your knowledge in a simulated Dutch Agile work environment at Motopp, work on applications in Sprints, and receive feedback from trainers and mentors. - Professional skills: Learn about Dutch work culture, communication, presentation techniques, CV building, and get introduced to Agile/Scrum methodologies. - Career: We do not offer a 100% job guarantee, but we do offer 100% job intention. Payroll Representative enables a best-in-class employee experience through payroll knowledge & service delivery. This role will support the payroll delivery for Germany in the EMEAI region. The main objective of this role is to ensure that the employees are paid on time and accurately, in compliance with the respective country tax-legislation, agreed labor conditions, company policies and regulations. In this role, you will require understanding of key business drivers for your discipline and function. You will need to be able to expand conceptual and working knowledge related to German Payroll. Requires full proficiency gained through job-related training and considerable on-the-job experience to perform a range of tasks under limited supervision. It is your responsibility to use technical experience, established practices, and personal judgement to analyze and resolve straightforward problems. Your performance impacts the quality of your own work and your team’s work and requires that you work within established guidelines and policies What’s your job about? Delivering Payroll, Time & Absence, and Data Management in a productive and efficient manner. Processing information with confidentiality and with a high level of accuracy. Ensuring accurate and timely payments to employees and local authorities. Perform activities according to the Dow internal control & compliance framework. Address employee queries/cases on payroll related matters in alignment with our internal Service Level Agreements (SLAs) What skills do you have? You have a Bachelor or Master's degree in HR, Finance, or related area. You bring a minimum of 2 years of payroll experience. Fluency in English & German (written & oral) is mandatory. Preferred Skills: Experience with MS Excel, Workday, ServiceNow & ADP Globalview payroll, SAP. Proficiency in any other European languages is an asset. Understand organizational interdependencies and experience working across functions and cultures. Experience i

high volume operational environments is required. Experience in internal controls through prior audit participation is preferred. Good problem solving, critical thinking skills and managing competing priorities. By nature, this job requires a substantial amount of coordination with a variety of internal- and external stakeholders where accountability and ownership of data and processes are key. Self-motivated with a customer service mindset. What do you get in return? Competitive Salary 13th month Travel and any tunnel costs will be reimbursed 28 vacation days This international organization distinguishes itself through its strong focus on innovation, technological expertise, and sustainable development. By combining knowledge, experience, and a global network, the organization develops high-quality solutions that contribute to the growth and continuity of its customers, partners, and society. Professionals from a wide range of disciplines work closely together within the organization, including supply chain, research and development, manufacturing, engineering, health and safety, sustainability, information systems, finance, and human resources. The combination of diverse backgrounds, areas of expertise, and cultures creates a dynamic working environment in which collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement are key. With a strong international presence and an extensive network of operational and support functions, the organization supports customers and partners around the world. By bringing together expertise and fostering close collaboration across different departments, innovative, efficient, and sustainable solutions are developed to address the challenges of today and tomorrow.
